instruction: Run MySQL performance schema query for slow queries
output: mysql -u root -p -e 'SELECT * FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10;'

instruction: Analyze MySQL table with ANALYZE TABLE

output: mysql -u root -p mydb -e 'SELECT TABLE_NAME, ROUND(DATA_LENGTH + INDEX_LENGTH) AS size, ROUND(DATA_FREE) AS free FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = "mydb";'
psql -U postgres mydb -c "CREATE INDEX idx_active_users ON users(email) WHERE active = true;"

psql -U postgres mydb -c "SELECT schemaname, tablename, n_dead_tup, n_live_tup, round(n_dead_tup::numeric/(n_live_tup+n_dead_tup+1)*100,2) AS dead_pct FROM pg_stat_all_tables WHERE n_live_tup > 0 ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 10;"
